参考文献

Why Functional Programming Matters, John Hughes, 1989.
在线可得: https://doi.org/10.1093/comjnl/32.2.98.

Boost.Lambda library, Jaakko Jarvi, 1999-2002 Jaakko Järvi, Gary Powell.
在线可得: http://www.boost.org/libs/lambda/.

Functional Programming in C++ using the FC++ Library: 一篇介绍 FC++ 的短文, Brian McNamara 和 Yannis Smaragdakis, 2001 年 4 月. 在线可得: https://people.cs.umass.edu/~yannis/fc++/.

Side-effects and partial function application in C++, Jaakko Jarvi 和 Gary Powell, 2001.
在线可得: https://parasol.tamu.edu/~jarvi/papers/mpool01.pdf.

Spirit Version 1.2, Joel de Guzman, 2001 年 11 月.
在线可得: http://spirit.sourceforge.net/index.php?doc=docs/v1_2/index.html.

Generic Programming Redesign of Patterns, Proceedings of the 5th European Conference on Pattern Languages of Programs, (EuroPLoP'2000) Irsee, Germany, 2000 年 7 月.
在线可得: http://www.coldewey.com/europlop2000/papers/geraud%2Bduret.zip.

A Gentle Introduction to Haskell, Paul Hudak, John Peterson 和 Joseph Fasel, 1999.
在线可得: http://www.haskell.org/tutorial/

Large scale software design (《大规模软件设计》) , John Lackos, ISBN 0201633620, Addison-Wesley, 1996 年 7 月.

Design Patterns, Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software (《设计模式:可复用面向对象软件的基础》) , Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Jhonson, and John Vlissides, Addison-Wesley, 1995.
